title: DWP takes some online services offline after identifying a cyber incident
date_note: The page gives no earlier day than its 27 November publication.
place: United Kingdom (national department; location of the incident not stated)
summary: The DWP said:"We have taken some DWP online services offline as a precaution after we identified a cyber incident affecting our systems." PA News reports it is working with the National Cyber Security Centre to investigate and restore services. The DWP says regular benefit and pension payments are not affected. The reports do not name the services.
plain: The DWP has taken some online services offline as a precaution after a cyber incident. It says benefit and pension payments are not affected and is working with the NCSC. The reports do not say which services.
exec: A UK government department has taken some online services offline after a cyber incident; the DWP says regular payments are unaffected.
action: The DWP advises anyone who cannot reach a service to try again later, and says it will never message people to ask for bank details or to click on links.

validation.note: PA News (via Diss Express and AOL/Evening Standard) and EFE (via ABC Color) are separate agencies; each reports the DWP saying it suspended some online services after a cyber incident and that regular payments are unaffected. The DWP page itself was not read.
